text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped by roughly 40%. Reps used that time for follow-ups, not extra meetings.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were consistent, so pipeline reviews stopped being guesswork.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking upfront, and explaining why, built trust fast.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Managers still had to coach on the "why."

**5. Adoption followed usefulness.** Reps embraced it once they saw their own follow-up emails improve.

The takeaway: AI note-takers work best as an assistant, not a replacement for judgment.

What did your team learn from piloting AI tools?
